author: Robert Grayson
message:
feat(ai): third engine — reaper, the dive brawler built to counter pilot

Pilot wins by holding a 200-420px range band with a height edge. Reaper
denies the band: relentless gap-close with an rng-jittered run-in, approach
ABOVE the target and cut jets to FALL onto it (gravity is the best juke),
knife-range commitment (full-auto inside 180px, push THROUGH the target,
reload only on a dry mag), 5s hunt memory, same ceiling-stall give-up as
pilot.

Tuned against live tournament telemetry in one iteration: v1 held fire
under 320px and ate free tap-bursts on the run-in — pilot swept 4-0
(84K/53D). v2 returns fire from 460px, approaches at 200px height (above
pilot's preferred edge), commits at 180px: round went 3-1 with one game
DECIDED ON TIEBREAK (16-16), two others by 2 kills, and reaper WON the
marksman variant 13-11. The meta has its first real rivalry.

reaper registers like any engine: ?ai=reaper, ?duel=pilot,reaper,
?tournament&ai=pilot,reaper, E-cycle. 439 tests green.

author: Robert Grayson
message:
feat: round system — team MVP scoreboards, 10-min round winners, knob variants shown in UI

ROUNDS: team matches end after 10 sim-minutes (?round=SECS overrides):
Game freezes (tick no-ops; UI/telemetry keep serving the final state), a
56px RED WINS / BLUE WINS / DRAW banner names the winning team AND its
engine, verdict = kills then total dominance then draw (pure
decideRoundWinner, tested). Telemetry dump().round carries the verdict.

PER-GAME TEAM SCOREBOARD: top-center panel in every team match — RED and
BLUE kill totals plus each team's winningest killer (MVP), live.

KNOB VARIANTS, SHOWN: GameTuning instance values (defaults = the old
constants exactly; ?play byte-identical) with 4 named variants — baseline /
high-octane / thin-air / marksman. The actual knob TURNS are spelled out in
the UI (banner: 'fire 6->4 · reload 95->70 · ...'; tournament sidebar per
game) and recorded in telemetry meta.

WHOLE TEAMS (user correction): in team matches each team is ENTIRELY one
engine, split evenly — a lopsided roster can never produce 1v5 'everyone is
on pilot'. Next round (N / printed URL) keeps the same whole teams on FRESH
generation-derived seeds instead of evolving rosters toward the winner;
the round champion across games = engine with most game wins (dominance
tiebreak). tools/run-tournament.mjs round mode waits for all 4 verdicts.

Live 20s-round tournament: pilot swept 4-0 across all four variants.
438 tests green (multi-agent workflow + correction pass).

seed = same match), aggregated sidebar standings (per-engine totals, crowned

the printed command starts round 2.

First live run (90s x 4 games): pilot crowned 124K/67D dom=90.5 vs classic
62K/125D dom=-0.5; all top-10 fighters were pilots; evolved roster 5:1
pilot. 408 tests green (12 new).

author: Robert Grayson
message:
fix(ai): pilot ceiling-cling — concede unwinnable height contests

Two pilots each demanding a 50px height edge over the other is a symmetric
arms race that ended with the whole match pinned to the ceiling slab
(user-reported). The brain now detects a stalled climb — burning jet for 25
consecutive ticks without actually rising — and concedes: thrust cut, all
climbing suppressed for ~3s (engage, reload-disengage, and hunt climbs all
gated), so gravity brings the duel back into the arena before the next
height bid. Screenshot-verified: pilot-only match spreads across the full
airspace. 399 tests green.

feat(client): big engine banners + live brain hot-swap (E key)

Engines now self-describe (BotEngine.strategy); every spectate window shows

author: Robert Grayson
message:
feat: swappable bot-AI engines (adapter) + ?duel side-by-side engine matches

The line in the sand (decision node 136): every bot brain now lives behind
one adapter seam — BotEngine/BotBrain in client/src/ai/ with a name registry.
Game takes aiEngine ('classic'|'pilot'|any registered id; unknown falls back
to classic), brains see the world plus client weapon state via a narrow
context, and their only output is their bot's control.

- classic: pure extraction of the existing brain (sim updateBot + spectate
  aim conversion + shared roam fallback) — behavior unchanged, play mode
  regression-tested
- pilot: first-principles aerial brain v0 (observation node 130): fights
  from above (height-edge seeking with fuel commit/reserve), keeps a
  200-420px range band, strafe-jukes on an rng clock to defeat constant-
  velocity lead aim, reloads on its own terms and disengages while dry,
  hunts last-seen positions for 4s after losing LOS, tap-bursts at range,
  time-of-flight lead + true ballistic drop compensation
- ?ai=<engine> picks the brain for any match; ?duel[=a,b] runs TWO
  simultaneous independent matches side by side (iframe per engine, own sim/
  renderer/telemetry each); telemetry meta now records the engine id

The duel paid for itself in its first minute: pilot v0 telemetry showed a
0.1% hit rate — a 60x overshoot in drop compensation — fixed and re-raced.
Final 90s comparison: pilot 35% hit rate / 291px median kill distance / 71%
jet use vs classic 22% / 164px / 46%. 396 tests green (6 new: registry
resolution + per-engine 6000-tick match sustainment + play-mode regression).

feat(client): Skyreach v2 — ceiling slab + irregular asymmetric pad layout

Height limit: bots hovering on the air-fuel trickle drifted upward until the

author: Robert Grayson
message:
feat: aerial-by-default — Skyreach arena, flying bots, spectate on startup

The game now opens on a bot-vs-bot AERIAL match (no params); ?play opts into
fighting, ?spectate=N still sets bot count, ?map= still picks stock maps.

- Skyreach: new default arena, 2800x~1000px — thin ground, tall walls, five
  tiers of narrow floating pads (perches, not floors); spawns biased to the
  mid/high tiers so fights start in the air
- Aerial bot AI (sim, DESIGN OVERRIDE node 124): chase ANY height advantage
  (was: only when target 180px overhead) + rng-rolled 25-45-tick jet BURSTS
  during engagements, fuel-reserve gated
- Air fuel trickle: coasting regenerates 1/tick (burn rate), so a 50% thrust
  duty cycle sustains a dogfight; ground regen stays 3/tick
- Spectate wander is now 2D: roam goals are random spawn pads (interior,
  reachable), bots FLY to elevated goals, and a stuck bot re-rolls its
  destination instead of pogo-ing in a corner (user-reported)
- Suicides are legal physics now (ballistic bullets fall back onto climbing
  shooters) — kill board already handled them; sustainment test updated

Telemetry before/after (2-min headless matches): jet use 1.7-3.8% -> 47-56%
of alive time, kill distance median 81 -> 169px, vertical spread ~500px,
airTime ~99%. 391 tests green.

author: Robert Grayson
message:
feat(client): match telemetry — versioned JSON schema + analyzer for gameplay math

Makes bot matches machine-parseable (soldat-match-telemetry/1): per-half-
second sprite samples (pos/vel/hp/jet fuel/jetting/firing/airborne), every
shot (Game.onShot), every damaging hit (new sim World.onDamage observer —

positions + distance. Derived stats computed in pure tested functions:
per-bot hit rates, jet-use %, airtime %, speed, vertical spread, kills/min,
kill-distance percentiles, grid-binned death clusters.

Spectate-only wiring: window.__match.dump() for CDP/agents, T key downloads
the JSON, tools/analyze-match.mjs renders a report. Normal play unaffected.

Proven end-to-end on a 2-min headless ctf_Ash match: 36 deaths (18/min),
aggregate hit rate 21.1%, kill-distance median 81px (p25 53 / p75 130 —
knife-fight range), jet use 1.7-3.8% per bot. The numbers confirm and
sharpen the spectate judge's verdict: pacing too hot, bots don't fly,
fights are point-blank. 386 tests green (6 new).

author: Robert Grayson
message:
feat(client): spectate mode — bot-vs-bot matches with broadcast director camera

?spectate (or ?spectate=N, 2-12 bots, default 6): a self-sustaining bot
deathmatch with no human soldier, an action camera, and a live scoreboard —
built to watch and judge the gameplay.

- Kill attribution: sim Sprite.lastHitBy (set on every damaging hit) +
  Game.onKill fired exactly once on the death edge; suicides/unattributed
  excluded from tallies
- Director (new director.ts, pure tested core): scores subjects by kill
  heat > firing > enemy proximity; 3.5s min dwell + hysteresis stops
  whiplash; dead subject cuts immediately, preferring its killer; arrows/N/P
  cycle bots manually, A/0 returns to auto; lerped broadcast pan with
  snap-cuts past 1500px
- HUD goes live in spectate: followed bot's name/vitals/ammo, FFA
  leader/runner-up scores, real kill feed
- Bot sustainment (spectate-gated): alpha=255 so bots can SEE each other —
  discovered normal-mode bots are pacifists today (findTarget skips
  alpha!==255 and nothing ever set alpha; promoting the fix to play mode is
  a deliberate follow-up) — plus absolute->relative bot aim conversion,
  real .PMS waypoint adoption, deterministic roam fallback with stuck
  jump/jet pulses
- Normal play byte-for-byte unchanged (every change spectate-gated;
  browser-regression verified)

Verified: 380/380 tests (26 new: director rules, kill board, 10k-tick match
sustainment, play-mode regression, sim lastHitBy); two 90s headless-Chrome
soaks (synthetic arena + ctf_Ash) with zero input — kills strictly
accumulating (29 and 57), all bots scoring, camera tracking live bots,
manual override cycling, normal mode regression-checked.

author: Robert Grayson
message:
feat(client): light aim assist — bend near-miss player shots onto targets

Player shots already pointed within ~9° of a live enemy (700px range) bend
up to ~2.9° onto the angularly-closest one at fire time. Player ONLY (bots
would become aimbots), applied BEFORE spread so spray bloom still punishes
held fire, and the crosshair is never moved — the assist is invisible help
for coarse keyboard aim, not aim hijacking (decision node 106).

applyAimAssist is a pure exported helper; 7 unit tests cover snap-within-
bend, cap-at-max-bend, cone/range rejection, closest-of-several, and the
±PI seam when aiming left. 354 tests green.

author: Robert Grayson
message:
fix(sim): boots/jump force clobbering — most-upward-wins + 90% side-jump vertical

Three bugs, one shape: a later force assignment stomping a stronger upward
force on the same tick (faithful to Pascal's assignment order, wrong for us):
- Jump + jet: jet ground-kick (-0.25) OVERWROTE the jump force (-0.66) —
  holding Shift while jumping nerfed the jump to a hop
- Running takeoff: ground movement overwrote jet lift with -RUNSPEEDUP
  (0.0197, below gravity 0.06) — you could never lift off while running
- Running jump: Pascal side-jump vertical is 0.25 vs 0.66 standing — ~1/3
  the height, i.e. 'I cant jump over basic land obstacles'. Side-jumps now
  keep 90% of the straight jump's vertical plus the horizontal kick

Ground forceY now combines via most-upward-wins (min of negatives) in the
movement branches and the jet kick; all marked DESIGN OVERRIDE (node 100).
3 new regression tests (jump-with-jet >= jump, running takeoff climbs,
side-jump > 0.7x straight jump). 347 tests green.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

author: Robert Grayson
message:
feat(sim): vertical rocket boots — 1.8x up-thrust, damped drift, big tank + ground regen

This is a VERY vertical game; the boots should rocket you UP, not sideways.
First deliberate DESIGN OVERRIDE of the faithful Pascal constants (decision
node 94, marked in code):
- JET_THRUST 0.1 -> 0.18 (net lift vs gravity triples: 0.04 -> 0.12)
- While the jet burns, lateral air force halves (JET_AIR_DRIFT = FLYSPEED/2)
  so boosting reads as up + steer; full air control returns when fuel is dry
- Fuel 250 -> 700 ticks (~11.7 s burn) + on-ground regen (3/tick, empty->full
  ~3.9 s) for player and bots — jets gate engagements, not movement
- Jet HUD bar fixed: was jetsCountReal (never decremented) over a hardcoded
  max of 100; now live jetsCount over JET_FUEL_MAX

Tests: 344 green, incl. new 'climbs more than it drifts' (vertical gain must
beat 1.5x horizontal drift while jetting) and dry-tank air-control restore.

author: Robert Grayson
message:
feat(client): keyboard-only controls — WASD move, IJKL aim, Space fire, Tab reload

The game is now fully playable with no mouse. IJKL drive a persistent aim
angle emitted through the unchanged Control.mouseAimX/Y offset contract:
dt-based two-phase rotation (3 rad/s fine-nudge for 80ms after each chord
change, then 14 rad/s swing) toward 8 octant targets, exact settle, instant
elevation-preserving mirror-flip for turnarounds, ±1px vertical-aim facing
bias. Space fires (W/Up is jump), Tab reloads (preventDefault on both key
events so focus never moves), Shift stays jetpack. Mouse remains optional:
3px-accumulated mousemove reclaims aim, any IJKL keydown takes it back
seeded from the last offset so the crosshair never jumps. Window blur now
clears all held keys (fixes latent stuck-key bug for ALL bindings).

Verified: typecheck + 339 tests green (20 new input tests); live headless-
Chrome CDP playtest with zero mouse events — movement, jump/jet, all aim
chords + persistence, ammo drain 30->21 on held Space, Tab reload, focus
retained after Tab. Multi-agent workflow: 3-lens design + judge, implement,
3-verifier adversarial check, 1 fix round.
